text: Every work begins as a seed: a real problem, worth solving.
Schools bring their students. Industry brings real requirements.
In the Studio, they build, across six classes, directing intelligent tools.
At the crossing, a reviewer tests every claim.
What passes is certified. Exactly what was tested, and nothing more.
Then the work gives back. Seventy percent to its builders. Fifteen percent to an open Commons.
Samatwam. Build it. Prove it. Give it back.
